title: Dry Month Social Venue Risk Ranking
dataSources: Alcohol habit events (`habit:alcohol`), caffeine intake (`habit:caffeine`), screen-time sessions (`habit:screen`), and fasting windows (`habit:fasting`).
app: Habit-boundary telemetry for Dry January, caffeine cutoffs, screen-before-bed limits, and fasting windows sent to Splunk HEC via apps, shortcuts, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:alcohol
| search challenge="dry_january"
| stats count as visit_count avg(drink_event_flag) as drink_rate by venue_name
| sort 0 - visit_count
description: Ranks venuess by dry-month venue risk.
value: Venue risk helps you see which social context is most likely to bend the rule.
implementation: Send dry-month venue risk events to `index=personal` and keep `venue_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of dry-month venue risk by venues.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which venuess stand out most for dry-month venue risk.
